name: io.github.GeminiGeorge22/fmf-controlplane
title: FMF Tools Control-plane
description: Who controls this contract on 5 EVM chains? $0.005-0.25/call, no API key.

tools.name: tempo_token
tools.description: Tempo TIP-20 token facts ($0.005 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Tempo TIP-20 token facts in one call: name, symbol, decimals, total supply, currency, paused flag, supply cap. HTTP GET https://controlplane-x402.fmf-x402.workers.dev/mpp/tempo/token. This MCP wrapper does not settle payment by itself; call with an MPP Payment Authorization header, or use mppx against the HTTP route.

tools.name: tempo_balances
tools.description: Tempo wallet balances ($0.005 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Every nonzero Tempo token-list balance for a wallet in one call, plus a USD stablecoin total. HTTP GET https://controlplane-x402.fmf-x402.workers.dev/mpp/tempo/balances. This MCP wrapper does not settle payment by itself; call with an MPP Payment Authorization header, or use mppx against the HTTP route.

tools.name: controlplane
tools.description: Who controls this contract (MPP) ($0.01 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Who controls this contract? Proxy implementation, admin/owner, Safe threshold, timelock delay (Ethereum, Base or Tempo) at a pinned block. HTTP GET https://controlplane-x402.fmf-x402.workers.dev/mpp/controlplane. This MCP wrapper does not settle payment by itself; call with an MPP Payment Authorization header, or use mppx against the HTTP route.

tools.name: v1_controlplane
tools.description: Who controls this contract (x402) ($0.01 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). EVM control-plane snapshot at a pinned finalized block. Pay 0.01 USDC on Base via x402. HTTP GET https://controlplane-x402.fmf-x402.workers.dev/v1/controlplane. This MCP wrapper does not settle payment by itself; call with an MPP Payment Authorization header, or use mppx against the HTTP route.

tools.name: v1_watch
tools.description: Watch a contract for 30 days ($0.25 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Watch one Ethereum/Base contract for 30 days: alert to your Discord channel webhook and/or HTTPS webhook when its proxy implementation, admin/owner, Safe threshold/owners or timelock delay changes (checked every 15 min). POST JSON {chain, address, discord_webhook?, webhook?}. HTTP POST https://controlplane-x402.fmf-x402.workers.dev/v1/watch. This MCP wrapper does not settle payment by itself; call with an MPP Payment Authorization header, or use mppx against the HTTP route.
